items.title: Travis Hunter played 4 snaps on offense, 29 on defense

items.title: Zac Taylor: We felt the presence of our defensive additions on Sunday
items.body_text: The biggest storyline of the Bengals offseason was the moves they made to improve their defense and the new players were front and center in Sunday's 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.

items.title: Ashton Jeanty: We're building a new culture that's going to win games
items.body_text: When the Raiders took running back Ashton Jeanty at the top of the first round in 2025, they had performances like Sunday's in mind.

items.title: Quarterback adversity has sparked growth for Kevin O'Connell
items.body_text: As high-end analytics go, the Vikings make the playoffs every other year.

items.title: Jim Harbaugh: We were too sloppy
items.body_text: Sunday night saw John Harbaugh win his first game as the head coach of the Giants, but it wasn't a great day for the whole Harbaugh family.
items.author: Josh Alper

items.title: Jaelan Phillips: Giving up 59 points is embarrassing, creates critical moment for Panthers

items.title: Matt LaFleur on taking points off the board: We're gonna be aggressive, go for the throat
items.body_text: The Packers continued a run of late-game meltdowns in Minnesota on Sunday afternoon and one of head coach Matt LaFleur's decision loomed large as they went from leading the Vikings to an 0-1 record.

items.title: Jaxson Dart: Identity starts at the top and we bought into John Harbaugh's plan
items.body_text: The Giants capped the first Sunday of the 2026 season with their first win under head coach John Harbaugh.

items.title: Dan Campbell was surprised when replay overturned an apparent Saints touchdown
items.body_text: On Sunday in Detroit, an apparent Jared Goff fumble that was picked up and returned for a Saints touchdown was overturned on replay.

items.body_text: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said during his postgame press conference on Sunday that he "slept really well" on Saturday night because of how "on top of it" quarterback Caleb Williams was in their final meeting.

items.body_text: After the Packers lost their final three games in 2024, they went out and traded for Micah Parsons right before the start of the 2025 season.

items.body_text: Trey Hendrickson signed a four-year, $112 million contract with the Ravens in March.

items.title: Cam Skattebo 3-yard touchdown gives Giants early 7-0 lead
items.body_text: The Giants have taken an early lead over the division-rival Cowboys with a touchdown on their opening drive.

items.title: Jayden Daniels on Stefon Diggs penalty: We have to be smarter
items.body_text: The Commanders drew within two points of the Eagles on a Stefon Diggs touchdown with 9:59 left to play on Sunday, but any thoughts of tying the game went away seconds after the wideout entered the end zone.

items.title: Geno Smith: I don't think I got touched once all day

items.title: Ashton Jeanty, Raiders top Dolphins 27-13
items.body_text: Ashton Jeanty had his third career 100-yard game and accounted for 147 yards in the Raiders' 27-13 victory over the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.title: Cardinals beat Chargers in NFL's biggest upset of Week 1
items.body_text: The Chargers were the NFL's biggest favorites, with a 9.5-point spread. Instead, the Cardinals won 26-14.

items.title: Report: Jets WR Omar Cooper to have MRI on injured ankle
